short.label: Short-term drawdown
short.text: fell 15% or more from its 3-month high

long.label: Long-term drawdown
long.text: 30% or more below its 5-year high, and that high is over a year old

consol.label: Consolidation
consol.text: has traded inside a 25% high-to-low band for 6 months or more

base.label: Multi-year base
base.text: price has compounded 7% a year or less (about a fixed deposit) for 5 years or more
